author: SnowSX3
body:
I've always wondered why the points shop nether star is on the hotbar of every map on Avicus.

Having the nether star in the hotbar wastes a slot where food, arrows or blocks could go.
It's always tossed out by the majority of players or moved into the inventory.

If there really is a need to have a points shop icon ( I don't quite understand why there is one in the first place but) can it be moved into the inventory so it's out the way?

I know I'm nitpicking here but I would like to know the communities' opinion about this.

title: Why is the star on the bar?

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
I'm actually 50-50 on this. Yes, the star takes up unnecessary space in the hotbar, but it's only one space. I've never played a map where, in the middle of a rush, I'd have to open my inventory just to switch to another material. All the necessary items should already be in the hotbar, like the sword, bow, pick, food, etc. The shop is also kind of useful in maps like Gladiator, where you can buy snowballs to shoot people off in the beginning.

One map that I could think of where an extra slot might be useful is Quintus, because if you want to hide anywhere, chances are, you don't have stone bricks in your hotbar, so you'd have to switch. Another map that it could be useful in is Senex I, because if you're tunneling, and someone comes looking for you, you most likely won't have smooth sandstone to cover up your tracks. Just my two cents.
